thag5.4:1.1: Yaṃ patthayāno dhammesu upajjhāyo anuggahi amataṃ abhikaṅkhantaṃ, kataṃ kattabbakaṃ mayā. || ||
thag5.4:2.1: anuppatto sacchikato sayaṃ dhammo anītiho; visuddhañāṇo nikkhaṅkho byākaromi tav' antike. || ||
thag5.4:3.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ, sadattho me anuppatto, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag5.4:4.1: appamattassa me sikkhā sussutā tava sāsane; sabbe me āsavā khīṇā, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. || ||
thag5.4:5.1: anusāsi maṃ ariyavatā, anukampī anuggahi; amogho tuyham ovādo; antevāsi 'mhi sikkhito 'ti. || || Sumano thero.
